description: The knowledge map: where each learning sits when laid out by what it means, read through the board's own filters. Positions are a deterministic 2-D projection of the stored vectors scaled into ±300 (a hint about distance); links join each learning to its nearest neighbours by cosine similarity in the full space (the evidence). A learning with no stored vector is counted (embedded of total) and left off — never positioned by a guess — and the daemon's own sentence says what the positions are.

result.basis: positions are a 2-D principal-component projection of the stored 4-dimensional vectors (deterministic); lines join each learning to its nearest neighbours by cosine similarity in the full space, above 0.50; 1 of 4 learnings have no vector yet and are not on the map
